_note: THE SPACE BOARD FAMILY, 4: THE PART IN THE DUNGEON. Raiders took the courier's case to a dungeon and their leader keeps
it. Get it, fly up, fit it. 19a's shape on a board, but a WEATHER satellite, so it is not 19a again.
THE GROUND HALF BUILDS TODAY: a board dungeon request, as 04a (LocTypeDungeon, played), with the part in a case at
LocDungeonItemMarker03LocRef, nearest the boss (same cell in 71 of 71 boss dungeons, median 18 m; 04a's lesson,
where the boss container itself put the case out of reach). The dungeon's own boss guards it; no spawned target.
THE ORBIT HALF DOES NOT: a board takes no second or third place but a request or a city. place.third.orbit on a board is a
PROPOSED, Eliza's; the beats kind's is the precedent (19a, played).
The broadcast plays outside the dungeon (step one's marker is inside, so it may need the entrance; 04a put step one
outside for this reason). Closing line on the radio. Pay: med, capped.

place._theme: A dungeon, as 04a. The lint measures the pool against what a request can place.

third._orbit: PROPOSED on a board (the beats kind builds it, 19a). 'planet', the orbit over the dungeon's planet, is the meaning wanted, and it NEVER STARTED on 19a, which played on 'player'. 'player' is wrong here: a board quest starts when the board refreshes, so the orbit would fill over wherever he stood then. Eliza's: the board's own target planet is the likely anchor.

prose.name: Recovery: Weather Satellite Part on <Planet>
prose.briefing: A crew took the replacement core for the weather satellite over <Planet> off its courier. Their leader at the <Place> has it.
prose.card: Local Contract. Recover the weather satellite's core from the <Place> and fit it. Payment on contract completion.

beats.objective: Recover the sensor core from the <Place>
beats.journal: I took the weather satellite's sensor core back from the leader at the <Place>. I need to fit it to the satellite over <Planet>.
beats._model: The C1 sealed courier case he cleared 2026-10-12 (04a's), which is what a courier would carry it in.
beats.name: Courier's Case
say: That's the core. Get it up to the satellite.

beats.objective: Fit the core to the weather satellite
beats.journal: The crew at the <Place> took the weather satellite's replacement core off its courier. I took it back and fitted it in orbit over <Planet>. The satellite is reading the weather again.
beats.name: Weather Satellite

message.title: Satellite Repaired
message.text: The core locks in. The satellite turns its sensors back to the planet below.

say: There's the data coming in, the first clear picture we've had in a week.

broadcast: The one in charge in there has our core. They took it off the courier thinking it's worth something, and it isn't, to anyone but us.
_speech: A forecaster, mild and a little dry. Voice: George (Warm, Captivating Storyteller), already in three recipes; his ear decides. No names, places, factions or currency.
